description: This file defines a custom Blazor component class 'CustomInputSelect<TValue>' that extends 'InputSelect<TValue>' to provide custom parsing logic, particularly for integer values, to work around limitations before .NET 5.0.

classes.name: CustomInputSelect<TValue>
classes.description: A custom Blazor input select component that adds specialized parsing support for integer types.

methods.name: TryParseValueFromString
methods.description: Overrides the base method to provide custom parsing logic for int types, ensuring input strings can be correctly converted to TValue.
